items.source: a builder to create the cookie with
items.translation: 用于创建 Cookie 的构建器。

items.source: name - the cookie name
items.translation: name - Cookie 名称

items.source: This limits the scope of the cookie such that it will only be attached to same site requests if "Strict" or cross-site requests if "Lax".
items.translation: 这将 Cookie 的作用域限制为：如果设置为 `"Strict"`，则仅附加到同源站点的请求；如果设置为 `"Lax"`，则附加到跨站点请求。

items.source:
A positive value indicates when the cookie expires relative to the
current time. A value of 0 means the cookie should expire immediately.
A negative value means no "Max-Age" attribute in which case the cookie
is removed when the browser is closed.
items.translation: 正值表示相对于当前时间的 Cookie 过期时间。值为 0 表示 Cookie 应立即过期。负值表示没有"Max-Age"属性，此时当浏览器关闭时 Cookie 将被移除。

items.source: An HttpCookie subclass with the additional attributes allowed in the "Set-Cookie" response header. To build an instance use the from(String) static method.
items.translation: 一个带有“Set-Cookie”响应头中允许的附加属性的 `HttpCookie` 子类。要构建实例，请使用静态方法 from(String)。

items.source: Factory method to obtain a builder that copies from HttpCookie.
items.translation: 用于从HttpCookie复制内容的构建器的工厂方法。

items.source: Factory method to obtain a builder for a server-defined cookie. Unlike from(String, String) this option assumes input from a remote server, which can be handled more leniently, for example, ignoring an empty domain name with double quotes.
items.translation: 用于获取服务器定义 Cookie 的构建器的工厂方法。与from(String, String)不同，此选项假设输入来自远程服务器，因此可以以更宽松的方式处理，例如忽略带有双引号的空域名。

items.source: Return the cookie "Domain" attribute, or null if not set.
items.translation: 返回 "Domain" 属性，如果未设置则返回 null。

items.source: Return the cookie "Path" attribute, or null if not set.
items.translation: 返回 Cookie 的 "Path" 属性，如果未设置则返回 `null`。

items.source: Return true if the cookie has the "HttpOnly" attribute.
items.translation: 如果 Cookie 具有 "HttpOnly" 属性，则返回 true。

items.source: Return true if the cookie has the "Partitioned" attribute.
items.translation: 如果 Cookie 具有 "Partitioned" 属性，则返回 true。

items.source: Return true if the cookie has the "Secure" attribute.
items.translation: 如果 Cookie 具有 "Secure" 属性，则返回 true。

items.source: Return a builder pre-populated with values from "this" instance.
items.translation: 返回一个预填充了来自"this"实例值的构建器。

items.source:
Factory method to obtain a builder for a server-defined cookie, given its
name only, and where the value as well as other attributes can be set
later via builder methods.
items.translation: 用于仅根据名称获取服务器定义 Cookie 的工厂方法，其中值以及其他属性可以通过构建器方法稍后设置。

items.source:
Factory method to obtain a builder for a server-defined cookie that starts
with a name-value pair and may also include attributes.
items.translation: 用于获取服务器定义的 Cookie 的工厂方法，该 Cookie 以名称 - 值对开头，并可能包含属性。
